target_blocks.text:
<!--@7¶1-->
Do **not** create six more 40-page specifications by default.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text:
<!--@7¶2-->
Run one bounded final decisions operation with six chapters:

target_blocks.text: 5. **Places and Projects**

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text: 6. **Corridor Progression and Metropolis**

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text:
<!--@7¶4-->
For every proposition, choose only:

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text: - **RETAIN** — valid without substantive change;

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text: - **REVISE** — concept survives, v0.5 wording/mechanics required;

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text: - **SUPERSEDE** — incompatible with controlling v0.5 canon;

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text: - **DEFER** — implementation, tuning, Sourcebook, or content-authoring work;

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text: - **OPEN** — genuine decision still required.

target_blocks.parent_heading: # V. Recommended final operation before architecture lock
target_blocks.text:
<!--@7¶6-->
The output should be a compact `MEDIAN_v0.5_Final_Baseline_Disposition.md`, not another persuasive design essay.

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text:
<!--@7.1¶1-->
The v0.5 architecture is ready to freeze when:

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text: - every item in the six packets has a disposition;

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text: - the resource/equipment taxonomy is mechanically coherent;

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text: - the Place/Project catalogue is known well enough to structure the Home chapters;

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text: - Record and naming authority is known well enough to structure Citizen/Memory chapters;

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text: - the world ontology is known well enough to structure corridor/biome chapters;

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text: - the Metropolis and victory arc have a settled architectural status;

target_blocks.parent_heading: ## Lock condition
target_blocks.text: - unresolved tuning is clearly separated from unresolved design.
